diagnosis: The Turborepo S3 cache proxy retrieves build artifacts using the client-specified X-Monorepo-Scope header without verifying that the authenticated user has access to that scope. A user with credentials for an open-source or public library within the monorepo can set X-Monorepo-Scope: @fintech/payments to download proprietary compiled artifacts from protected packages.

Authorization: Bearer token_open_source_contributor
